The Royal Society Te Apārangi Catalyst project on snowlines of the Tasman Glacier began in
October 2025. It uses polarimetric RADARSAT Constellation Mission data, with Rodrigo
Gomez-Fell as an Associate Investigator. See the
[project description](../projects.qmd#rcm-glaciers).
